description: Defines the interface class 'resource_grid_writer' for writing resource elements in a resource grid, including methods for placing symbols with various subcarrier and position configurations.

classes.name: resource_grid_writer
classes.description: Interface for writing resource elements into a resource grid, with methods for placing symbols and accessing grid views.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Places resource elements into the grid at specified port, symbol, and subcarrier positions, with overloads for different input types and positioning strategies.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Returns a modifiable view of a specific OFDM symbol for a given port.
